patch_description: Give moderate-demand OD pairs a little more influence in the two-hop rewards without changing the existing transit-node capacity discount or increasing the quadratic-term count. Replacing the purely linear path-demand factor with a mostly linear, mildly concave blend may improve typical sampled topologies by broadening useful path support, while retaining emphasis on large demands. The 15% concave share is deliberately modest so it does not overwhelm the direct-demand signal.
